description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeDao class within the OrangeHRM system. It contains multiple test methods that verify the behavior of EmployeeDao's methods related to employee hierarchy, employee data retrieval, and email availability checks.

classes.name: EmployeeDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class designed to verify various functionalities of EmployeeDao, including subordinate relationships, employee listing, email validation, and work shift retrieval.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeDao instance and sets up test fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of subordinate employee IDs for a given supervisor.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateList
methods.description: Tests obtaining subordinate employees for a supervisor.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateList_ReportingChain_Simple2LevelHierarchy
methods.description: Verifies subordinate list for a simple 2-level hierarchy.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateList_ReportingChain_3LevelHierarchy
methods.description: Verifies subordinate list for a 3-level hierarchy.

methods.name: testIsSupervisor
methods.description: Checks if a given employee ID is recognized as a supervisor.

methods.name: getEmployeeIds
methods.description: Helper method to extract employee IDs from a list of Employee objects.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeIdList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all employee IDs.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeIdListOneEmployee
methods.description: Verifies behavior when only one employee exists in the database.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployees
methods.description: Tests deletion of employee records by their IDs.

methods.name: testGetSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of supervisor IDs for a given subordinate.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeWorkShift
methods.description: Checks retrieval of an employee's work shift.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeList
methods.description: Verifies employee list retrieval with filters, sorting, and subunit filtering.

methods.name: testGetEmpNumbersByFilterParams
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee numbers based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeCount
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of employee count retrieval based on filters.

methods.name: testGetEmailList
methods.description: Ensures the email list retrieval returns correct email data.

methods.name: testIsWorkEmailIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks email availability validation logic for existing and non-existing emails.
